{{Quote|A weakened enemy is a defeated enemy|Darth Adacia|<ref name="Spiteful Saber">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=item|Spiteful Saber|[[Sabacc Sav]] on [[Carrick Station]] and [[Morro the Reaper]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]]}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Adacia''' was an individual<ref name="Spiteful Saber" /> affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Sith" /> They claimed that a weakened enemy was a defeated enemy.<ref name="Spiteful Saber" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Adacia was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', a [[2019]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, they are mentioned in the description for the "Spiteful Saber" Tactical item as the author of a quote provided in it.<ref name="Spiteful Saber" />
